Population increased in Devon

The estimated population of Devon in 2024 was 842,313 usual residents, a rise of 1.1% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Devon increased by 3.4%.

Age profile of Devon

The average (median) age fell to 47.6 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Devon has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, Devon's population of 842,313 usual residents was made up of:

  • 130,193 people aged 0 to 15 years, (15.5%)
  • 490,392 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.2%)
  • 221,728 people aged 65 years and over, (26.3%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Devon has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (26.3% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Devon, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Devon
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Devon, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 3,448 people (-0.4%). In total, there were 6,050 births and 9,498 deaths in Devon.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 8,769 (1.1%). There were 44,543 people entering the area and 35,774 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Devon's population of 3,967 (0.5%) as a result of 8,762 people entering the area and 4,795 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Devon was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Devon in mid-2023 is 833,527.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 841 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 722 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 119 people.
